summary: Off-registry HTTP dependency source enables install-time code execution
details: package.json declares the dependency `marker-index-symbol-schema` with its source set to the bare HTTPS URL `https://artifacts.creditslib.com/npm/marker-index-symbol-schema` instead of an npm registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever tarball that host returns and installs it, running any lifecycle scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall) it ships. The source is unpinned (no version, no commit, no integrity hash) and the host `artifacts.creditslib.com` is not an npm registry and is unrelated to any declared publisher or homepage. The shipped `index.js` is an inert stub that only re-exports the fetched dependency, so the manifest line is effectively the entire published payload: whoever operates creditslib.com controls arbitrary code execution on every installer at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
